_comment: Master layout for the Spaceship HUD. Base canvas 2560x1600 (16:10). Every skin reads its position from Layout.inc, which is generated from this file. Multiply by #Scale# at runtime.

zones.content: Power draw bar (system W: CPU+GPU package, battery discharge/charge W)
Battery % bar + time to 80% (charging) or time to empty
Row 1: GPU mode tabs ECO | HYBRID | AUTO | dGPU | OFF-HUD. Row 2: power mode, refresh rate, 80% charge limit, perf tier, CARGO (all-apps drawer)
Warning triangle + count (temps, disk, battery, dGPU awake)
FIXED: CPU usage history graph
SELECTABLE: GPU load / GPU temp / VRAM / CPU temp / disk I/O / network / power
SELECTABLE: same list as G2
FIXED: RAM usage history graph
Category 1 (default Aircraft Design): app-name tabs on top, hollow neon wireframe of the selected app, LAUNCH button
LAT / LON / ALT coordinate bar with crosshair glyph (mask toggle for screenshots)
Page dots: cycle which category the left panel shows
Pinned app 1 (hollow neon icon, name, status: running/not)
Pinned app 2
Pinned app 3
Pinned app 4
Category 2 (default CFD & Analysis): same behaviour as L_category
BLACK-CLOVER / Win11 build / CPU / GPU / RAM / uptime / local IP
Page dots for the right category panel
Pinned app 5
Pinned app 6
Pinned app 7
Pinned app 8
Perf-tier ring (FULL / LITE / LOW / STEALTH)
dGPU state ring (asleep / awake / MUX)
Orange target lock: top process by CPU, its CPU % and RAM (e.g. 567m = 567 MB)
Flight HUD: centre reticle + clock, left tape = CPU clock, right tape = GPU clock, readout = fan speed
3D wireframe radar sphere: top 8 processes as blips, ring pulses with network traffic
Storage: C: 361/954 GB ring, read/write bars, SSD temp + health, extra drives
Audio: output device, volume arc, mic mute, now playing + controls, live waveform
Network: up/down sparkline, Wi-Fi SSID + signal, ping
Mission clock: date, focus/pomodoro timer, next calendar event
General info strip: CPU C, GPU C, fans RPM, processes, ping, battery wear, power plan, uptime

overlays.content: CARGO drawer (transient): all app categories as drop-downs. While open, C_target and C_hud fade out; closes on launch or after 10 s.
